sections.title: Describing a drink or food
sections.content: To say what a drink or food is like, put the noun and the adjective together, with no verb: *A kávé meleg.* (The coffee is hot.) Two new words: *meleg* (hot, warm) and *hideg* (cold). You know *finom* (delicious) and *nagyon* (very): *A torta nagyon finom.*

items.spanish: A tea meleg, a limonádé hideg.
items.english: The tea is hot, the lemonade is cold.

sections.content: There is no *van* in these sentences, as in *A tej olcsó*: the noun and the adjective are enough.
